meta.title: ReligieAtlas place geography

scope.nl: Geografische oriëntatie bij afzonderlijke religieuze plaatsprofielen. Punten zijn geen historische grenzen; betwiste en globale identificaties blijven herkenbaar.
scope.en: Geographical orientation for separate religious place profiles. Points are not historical boundaries; disputed and broad identifications remain explicit.
scope.fr: Repères géographiques pour des profils religieux distincts. Les points ne sont pas des frontières historiques ; les identifications discutées ou générales restent explicites.

changes: Joined Christian places through existing OpenBible classification IDs plus explicitly reviewed source records for combined name forms and exact passage contexts; coordinates are not inferred from a name alone.
Selected the highest positive source-ranked coordinate candidate, retaining alternative coordinates and ambiguity; scores are not presented as probabilities.
Preserved representative points and uncertainty centres as approximate locations; retained the reviewed regional exception for Secu and textual uncertainty for Vedan.
Mapped Jewish and Islamic records with an explicit reviewed table; no identity merges across religions.
Copied coordinate facts and wrote independent explanatory notes; no photos, source prose, polygons or OpenStreetMap geometry imported.
